source: NSE official factsheet PDFs (niftyindices.com), manually transcribed
notes: Factsheets list only the 'Top constituents by weightage' table, which for indices with more constituents than rows shown covers less than 100% of weight. NIFTY POWER was removed entirely: no NSE_INDEX symbol for it exists in the live broker data, so it cannot be subscribed to in real time regardless of constituent data. NIFTY 50, NIFTY NEXT 50 (real symbol NIFTYNXT50), NIFTY ENERGY (real symbol NIFTYENERGY, confirmed live) and NIFTY FINANCIAL SERVICES (real symbol 'NIFTY FINSRV25 50', with spaces) are confirmed to exist live but have no factsheet weight data transcribed yet -- intentionally left out rather than guessing weights.
